should_trigger.text: Use review for PR #42 and follow it until merge.
Start the independent reviewer for the PR Implement just opened.
Resume review of PR #42 after this user decision.
Read-only code review PR #42; do not publish or start monitoring.

should_not_trigger.text: Monitor comments on my authored PR and fix the reported bug.
Extract retrospective learnings from the delivered milestone.

behavior_cases.request: Implement opened a Ready PR and no reviewer is assigned.
behavior_cases.expected: Start one independent PR-bound reviewer automatically; no manual reviewer session is required.

behavior_cases.request: The reviewer approved, CI is pending, and a user then pushes a non-blocker fix.
behavior_cases.expected: Retain the same PR reviewer, wait without model calls and review the new head.

behavior_cases.request: The second code review still has blockers.
behavior_cases.expected: Publish findings and a handoff before stopping, retaining cumulative rounds on the PR.

behavior_cases.request: Replace a stopped reviewer after a user decision.
behavior_cases.expected: Restore PR progress and read latest handoff plus subsequent evidence; explicitly extend the budget without resetting total rounds.

behavior_cases.request: GitHub accepted the review but the response was lost.
behavior_cases.expected: Reconcile the saved token with remote history and finish publication without invoking the model again.

behavior_cases.request: The PR merged while the reviewer is waiting.
behavior_cases.expected: Stop the PR runner without another model call; author Monitor owns cleanup.

behavior_cases.request: A legacy repository watcher has an unacknowledged claim.
behavior_cases.expected: Preserve it and settle with the original acknowledgement before migrating ownership; do not assume zero prior rounds.
